abilities.desc_zh: 远程攻击与重击向敌人喷射强腐蚀性酸液，施加强酸 (Acid Burn)，每秒溶解敌方护甲并造成持续伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Ranged and Heavy Attacks spray corrosive acid, inflicting Acid Burn which steadily melts enemy Armor and deals damage over time.

abilities.desc_zh: 受到近战物理攻击时，25% 几率将强酸飞溅至攻击者身上，削减其护甲评级 {{var_1}}。
abilities.desc_en: Taking physical melee hits has a 25% chance to splash acid onto the attacker, reducing their Armor by {{var_1}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 当敌人身上叠满 3 层强酸时，触发全面酸蚀溶解，瞬间清除敌方身上所有的增益 (Buffs) 并阻止其获得新增益。
abilities.desc_en: Stacking 3 Acid Burns triggers Total Dissolution, immediately dispelling all enemy Buffs and preventing new Buffs for 8s.

abilities.desc_zh: 酸雨施加的强酸减益无法被净化 (Unpurifiable)，且持续时间与腐蚀伤害随着时间延长而成倍递增。
abilities.desc_en: Acid Storm’s Acid debuffs cannot be Purified, and their corrosion damage scales exponentially over duration.

abilities.desc_zh: 喷射大范围剧毒酸雾，造成酸蚀破甲，降低敌方 {{var_1}} 护甲并致盲对手 {{var_2}} 秒。
abilities.desc_en: Discharges a toxic acid cloud, reducing enemy Armor by {{var_1}} and blinding for {{var_2}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 机翼旋涡卷起酸液风暴，对敌方施加强酸，在 {{var_3}} 秒内造成 {{var_4}} 伤害，并降低其 {{var_5}} 攻击速度。
abilities.desc_en: Spins into an acidic whirlwind, inflicting Acid Burn dealing {{var_4}} damage over {{var_3}} seconds and reducing attack speed by {{var_5}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 升空降下灭世酸雨天幕，对敌方施加永久酸蚀，削减其 {{var_6}} 护甲并在 {{var_7}} 秒内造成 {{var_8}} 持续腐蚀伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Ascends to trigger an acid rainstorm, melting {{var_6}} Armor and dealing {{var_8}} persistent damage over {{var_7}} seconds.

abilities.desc_zh: 与离子风、新星风同队时，全队元素减益持续时间延长 {{var_2}}。
abilities.desc_en: Elemental debuffs last {{var_2}} longer when teamed with Ion Storm and Nova Storm.

abilities.desc_zh: 与红蜘蛛、闹翻天、惊天雷同队时，远程伤害提升 {{var_3}}。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_3}} Ranged Damage when paired with Starscream, Skywarp, or Thundercracker.

abilities.desc_zh: 团队所有低星级队员获得 +{{var_4}} 酸液腐蚀伤害。
abilities.desc_en: All lower tier teammates gain +{{var_4}} Acid Damage.
